data.name: Carolyne
data.gender_notes: Carolyne is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Kara' meaning 'dear' and 'Yvon' meaning 'Jonas' or 'Dove'. Carolyne was a popular name for Christian girls as it symbolized devotion to God and purity. The name Carolyne carries the meaning “Darling of the Lord” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Carolyne usually hope their child will grow to embody darling of the lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder to keep one's faith and love for the Lord close to heart.
data.etymology: Carolyne belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Darling of the Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Carolyne total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: קרולין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קרולין הוא נגזר מהשם העברי קורל, שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא האור שלי'. השם הוא צורה נשית של השם קרול, שמקורו בשם הגרמני קרל, שפירושו 'אדם חופשי'. עם זאת, השם קרולין קשור גם לשם העברי נור, שפירושו 'אור'. השם נמצא בשימוש נרחב בקרב הנוצרים, ומשמעותו הרוחנית היא 'אור אלוהים' או 'אלוהים הוא האור שלי'.

in_greek.name: Καρολίν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καρολίν είναι μια μορφή του ονόματος Καρόλος, που προέρχεται από το γερμανικό όνομα Karl, που σημαίνει 'ελεύθερος άνθρωπος'. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα Καρολίν συνδέεται με το όνομα Νορ, που σημαίνει 'φως'. Η πνευματική σημασία του ονόματος Καρολίν είναι 'φως του Θεού' ή 'ο Θεός είναι το φως μου'.

in_latin.name: Carolyne
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Carolyne derivatur ex nomine Germanico Karla, quod significat 'homo liber'. In traditione Latina, nomen Carolyne coniungitur cum nomine Carolus, quod etiam significat 'homo liber'. Significatio spiritualis nominis Carolyne est 'lux Dei' vel 'Deus est lux mea'.

in_english.name: Carolyne
in_english.long_meaning: The name Carolyne is derived from the Germanic name Karl, meaning 'free man'. It is also associated with the Hebrew name Nur, meaning 'light'. In Christian tradition, Carolyne symbolizes spiritual illumination and guidance. The name has been in use since the Middle Ages and is popular across various Christian cultures.

data.cultural_impact: Carolyne has long been a beloved name for Christian girls, evoking images of grace, beauty, and piety. Its roots in Greek traditions show a connection to the rich history and culture of ancient Christianity, making it a popular choice for families who value their faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Carolyne holds deep spiritual significance for many Christians, representing the ideal of a dedicated follower of God. The name's derivation from the Greek words 'Kara' meaning 'dear' and 'Yvon' meaning 'Jonas' or 'Dove' symbolizes the unwavering love and devotion one should have for God, as well as the purity and peace brought by His presence.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Carolyne: Derived from Charles, meaning "free man," in Carolyne, the feminine form adds the divine female energy of Mary, emphasizing the strength and grace of a woman who is deeply connected to both the divine masculine and feminine aspects.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Carolyne was a popular name among French royalty in the 15th century. The name Carolyne carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
